title: New: Record a voice note in the Share sheet
summary: You can record a voice note right inside the iPhone Share sheet while a live waveform follows your voice, and the note goes along with whatever you share.

payload.title: You can talk about what you share without leaving the app
payload.body: The microphone in Add to Trillion now records right there, so you never leave the app you shared from.

payload.title: Talk about what you share
payload.body: Share a photo, link or file to Trillion and tap the microphone. You see the time and a waveform that moves with your voice. Tap stop to add your voice note to the share, then tap Send to give both to your AIs.
